title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-04-03
content:
2026-04-03 PM scratchpad - Aisha Patel

Morning priorities:
- Finalize PRD edits for low-latency defaults (see confluence link). Need to add: acceptance criteria, rollout phasing, and fallback policy examples.
- Sync w/Eng on kernel-selection heuristic change (Marco 10:30). Prepare list of expected perf regressions and mitigation plan.
- Send follow-up to SRE and infra about capacity for Dedicated preview (ask for headroom numbers + estimated lead time).

Top 3 for today:
1) PRD: update rollout section + add QA checklist + de-risking plan (target: 1st draft by EOD)
2) Engineering blockers: kernel heuristic validation + small perf regression on 4k context (need JIRA ticket + owner)
3) Launch checklist: verify telemetry keys + tracing hooks + cost-estimation table for docs

PRD edits notes (quick bullets to copy into doc):
- Acceptance criteria (must be measurable): 
  * 95th pctile latency < 220ms for 512 tokens on dedicated-small profile under steady-state load
  * No more than 2% request error rate increase vs baseline for top-10 routes
- Rollout phase -> staged canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) over 72h with automatic rollback threshold at +10% error or +25% latency
- Fallback policy examples: route to quantized model variant; route to a regional fallback; degrade to cached response for repeated prompts
- QA checklist: synthetic perf run, smoke traffic, annotation-quality sample check (10 prompts), cost-run numbers for 1M tokens/day

Open questions / TODOs:
- Do we require an opt-in for existing Dedicated customers? (check legal/compliance) -> ping Jenna from compliance
- Need final wording for "degrade to cached response" behavior in API docs (API team review)
- Who will own post-launch cost-monitoring? Suggest eng-cost team + product ops (Marco to propose)

Stakeholder follow-ups (quick email drafts):
- To Marco C: "Quick ask — can you bring the kernel-selection perf runs to the 10:30 sync? Include variance numbers and the 99th pctile. If there are known regressions for 4k, call them out and propose a short mitigation timeline."
- To SRE (Sofia): "Asking for capacity headroom for Dedicated preview: willing to accept conservative estimates. Need expected time to spin up 50 vGPUs and any constraints on region placement by EOD."
- To Legal/Compliance (Jenna): "Confirm whether Dedicated customers must sign updated terms for rollout of new inference defaults. If yes, need compliance timeline."

Launch checklist (working) - copy to formal checklist later:
[ ] PRD finalized + reviewed by Eng/SRE/Legal
[ ] Canaries implemented + automated rollback configured
[ ] Telemetry + tracing endpoints validated (test traces show up within 5s)
[ ] Cost estimate published + finance sign-off
[ ] Docs updated (API behavior, fallback examples)
[ ] Support playbook written + initial playbook run-through with CS
[ ] Post-launch eval set created (prompt set, eval metrics, quality thresholds)

Meeting notes (10:30 kernel heuristic sync):
- Marco: runs show kernel change improves throughput by ~18% median, but 99th pctile increased by ~12% on long context workloads
- Action: Marco to try hybrid scheduling: new kernel for short sequences, fallback for >2k tokens; run overnight test and post numbers in RED-2987
- Need to add regression-gate in rollout if 99th pctile > +8%

Quick personal TODOs:
- Block 2pm-3pm for PRD writing (deep work)
- 4pm: sync w/Sales onboarding to confirm Dedicated preview customers list
- Remind: add a short FAQ entry about fallback behavior in API docs (one paragraph)

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Consider adding a toggle in the console to prefer "latency-optimized" vs "cost-optimized" profiles per-route (good sales convo + product hook)
- Could we expose the kernel-selection heuristic as a per-deployment setting? Might be too much surface area but useful for dedicated customers who want max throughput

End-of-day goals:
- PRD: first full pass complete and comments solicited from Marco + Sofia
- Launch checklist: initial items ticked and owners assigned in the launch doc
- Send capacity follow-up to SRE

Random notes/links to paste into PRD later:
- JIRA RED-2987: kernel-selection perf runs
- Confluence: PRD v2 low-latency features (link above)
- PR: hosted-api/pull/242 (docs + example throttle)

Unresolved / parking lot:
- Decide whether to include "degrade to cached response" as a soft or hard SLA (talk to legal)
- Follow up re: customer notification strategy for Dedicated defaults

---
Small wins yesterday:
- Demoed canary rollback in staging -> worked as expected (rolled back in 4m after threshold)
- Pricing spreadsheet now includes per-route cost calc (Marco added sparse examples)

Sign-off: Aisha
